edges.source_entity_name: Goat Milk Pancakes with Fresh Egg Syrup
edges.fact: Goat Milk Pancakes with Fresh Egg Syrup are made by whipping up fluffy pancakes using goat milk

edges.source_entity_name: Eggs en Cocotte with Goat Milk Cream
edges.fact: Eggs en Cocotte with Goat Milk Cream is made by baking eggs in ramekins with a splash of goat milk, salt, and pepper

edges.source_entity_name: Goat Milk Crepes with Scrambled Eggs and Fresh Herbs
edges.fact: Goat Milk Crepes with Scrambled Eggs and Fresh Herbs are made using thin crepes made with goat milk

edges.source_entity_name: Quiche Lorraine with Goat Milk and Fresh Eggs
edges.fact: Quiche Lorraine with Goat Milk and Fresh Eggs is made by mixing fresh eggs, goat milk, grated cheese, and diced ham or bacon into a pre-baked pie crust

edges.source_entity_name: Breakfast Strata with Goat Milk and Fresh Eggs
edges.fact: Breakfast Strata with Goat Milk and Fresh Eggs is a layered dish made with cubed bread, fresh eggs, goat milk, and shredded cheese

edges.source_entity_name: Goat Milk French Toast with Caramelized Bananas and Scrambled Eggs
edges.fact: Goat Milk French Toast with Caramelized Bananas and Scrambled Eggs is made by dipping thick slices of bread in a mixture of goat milk, eggs, and cinnamon

edges.source_entity_name: Eggs in Purgatory with Goat Milk and Spinach
edges.fact: Eggs in Purgatory with Goat Milk and Spinach has eggs poached in a spicy tomato sauce made with goat milk, served with wilted spinach and feta cheese

edges.source_entity_name: Goat Milk Custard Tarts with Fresh Egg Yolks
edges.fact: Goat Milk Custard Tarts with Fresh Egg Yolks are made by mixing goat milk, sugar, and egg yolks into pre-baked tart shells
Fresh Chevre (goat cheese) requires 1 gallon of goat milk, heated to 86°F (30°C), plus cheese cultures and rennet
Goat Milk Ricotta requires 1 quart of goat milk combined with heavy cream, salt, and vinegar or lemon juice, heated to 180°F (82°C)
Goat Milk Mozzarella requires 1 gallon of goat milk, heated to 86°F (30°C), with citric acid and rennet added
Goat Milk Feta requires 1 gallon of goat milk, heated to 86°F (30°C), with cheese cultures and rennet added
